gbm_population_evidence.quote: Suspected of having a high-grade glioma based on preoperative multimodal MRI,

candidate_evidence.quote: ex-vivo organoid cultures composed of tumor cells within their microenvironment (glioblastoma organoid - GBO) and intra- and peri-tumoral blood vessels (blood vessel organoid - BVO), derived from perioperative samples obtained during complete or partial surgical resection
All patients will be planned to receive standard of care for glioblastoma after resection, namely radiotherapy+temozolomide and TTFields.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: derived from perioperative samples obtained during complete or partial surgical resection in patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma.

agents.agent_name_registered: temozolomide (standard of care, not a registered intervention)

role_evidence.quote: All patients will be planned to receive standard of care for glioblastoma after resection, namely radiotherapy+temozolomide and TTFields.

coder_notes: Phase NA ex vivo organoid feasibility study; the only registered intervention is an ex vivo laboratory procedure (no drug given as study intervention). Temozolomide listed as soc_backbone because all patients are planned to receive standard radiotherapy + temozolomide. Population: conditions name only glioblastoma and outcome refers to patients with glioblastoma, but inclusion is 'suspected high-grade glioma' on MRI; coded gbm_only (could be argued high_grade_glioma_unspecified; does not change exclusion since no candidate). Experimental treatment of organoids and plasma biomarkers are ex vivo/correlative; no named tumour molecular biomarker.
